reviews.comment:
Atienen sin ganas y tratando mal al cliente. Terminé en la Shell. Viernes 00.30hs aprox, un solo auto había cargando, me frené un segundo a ver un cartel con una promo que tenían y escucho un “avance” apurándome con toda la mala onda, como los policías de cancha, encima lo veo por el espejo que hace gestos a su compañero. Me fui a la Shell que saben atender en serio

(Translated by Google)
They serve without enthusiasm and treat customers badly. I ended up at the Shell station. Friday, around 12:30 a.m., there was only one car filling up. I stopped for a second to look at a sign with a promotion they were running, and I heard someone yelling "come on!" in a really bad mood, like a policeman at a soccer game. To top it off, I saw him in the rearview mirror gesturing to his partner. I went to the Shell station that knows how to provide proper service.
